marks_structure.extra_time_note: Haan — 15 minute reading time milta hai. Paper padho, OR options decide karo.
marks_structure.internal_assessment_note: Theory mein 56 mein se kam se kam 20 aur practical mein 30 mein se 10 marks laane zaroori hain. Dono mein alag-alag pass karna hoga.

paper_overview.sets_note: RBSE mein multiple sets hote hain. Har set mein same questions, sirf order alag.
paper_overview.all_compulsory_note: Section C (Long Answer Q16-18) aur Section D (Essay Q19-20) mein internal choice (OR option) milta hai.
paper_overview.ncert_enough: RBSE Biology ka syllabus NCERT par based hai. NCERT ke sare chapters thoroughly padho. SP Examination Idea Biology bhi zaroori hai.
paper_overview.official_scheme_note: Biology mein labelled diagrams bahut important hain — har long/essay answer mein diagram se extra marks milte hain. Section D ke 4-mark essay questions — Molecular Basis of Inheritance (Ch 6) aur Human Health & Diseases (Ch 8) se typically aate hain — ye dono 11% weightage chapters hain.

question_types_in_exam.summary: RBSE Biology paper: 20 main questions, 51 sub-questions, 56 marks. Section A = MCQ(0.5) + Fill(0.5) + VSA(1). Section B = Short(1.5). Section C = Long(3). Section D = Essay(4).

types.how_to_attempt: Sirf correct option (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) likhna hai. No explanation. 0.5 mark ke liye 30 second se zyaada mat do.
types.mostly_from: All chapters — definitions, organism names, process names, diseases and causative agents, diagram identification.

types.how_to_attempt: One scientific term, organism name, or process name likhna hota hai.
types.mostly_from: Scientific names, specific terms (sporopollenin, synergid, MHC), disease causative agents, chromosome numbers.

types.how_to_attempt: Define term, name organism/process, or one-sentence answer. Scientific names correctly likhna zaroori.
types.mostly_from: Definitions (Apomixis, Parthenocarpy, Linkage), conditions, names of scientists.

types.how_to_attempt: 1.5 marks = concept/definition (0.5) + explanation/example (0.5) + diagram if asked (0.5). 4-5 lines sufficient.
types.mostly_from: All 13 chapters — distinction questions, short process explanations, simple diagrams.

types.how_to_attempt: 3 marks = concept (1) + explanation with steps/diagram (1.5) + conclusion/significance (0.5). Labelled diagram compulsory where applicable.
types.mostly_from: Reproduction (embryo sac, double fertilization), Genetics (crosses, DNA), Ecology (pyramids, nutrient cycles), Biotechnology.

types.how_to_attempt: 4 marks = introduction (0.5) + detailed explanation with labelled diagram (2) + steps/mechanism (1) + significance/conclusion (0.5). Diagrams are essential.

paper_pattern.note: RBSE Biology theory paper = 56 marks. 4 sections (A-D). 20 main questions (51 sub-questions). Duration 3 hours 15 minutes (15 min reading time extra).
paper_pattern.internal_choice_note: Section C (Long Answer Q16-18) aur Section D (Essay Q19-20) mein internal choice (OR option) milta hai.

sections.notes: Sare 34 sub-parts attempt karo. No negative marking.

sections.breakdown: Q16, Q17, Q18 — 3 questions × 3 marks each = 9 marks. Internal OR choice milti hai.
sections.notes: 3 questions with OR choice. Labelled diagram compulsory for full marks.

sections.name: Section D — Essay Type
sections.breakdown: Q19 aur Q20 — 2 questions × 4 marks each = 8 marks. Internal OR choice milti hai.
sections.notes: 2 essay questions with OR choice. Expected from Ch 5 (Molecular Basis) and Ch 7 (Human Health). Complete diagram + explanation zaroori.

sections.breakdown: Q4 to Q15 — 12 questions × 1.5 marks each = 18 marks. Sare compulsory.

tips: Section A ke 34 sub-parts (21 marks) — sab attempt karo, no negative marking
Section D essays = 8 marks — Ch 5 (DNA replication) aur Ch 7 (Immunity/AIDS) prepare karo
Diagrams pencil se banana — neater hota hai, labels pen se
Scientific names correctly likhna — Plasmodium vivax, Bacillus thuringiensis etc.
Section B ke 12 short answers (18 marks) = 32% of paper — sab compulsory, koi mat chhodna
PCR ke teen steps ke temperatures yaad karo — 94°C, 45-55°C, 72°C
Ecological pyramid — energy pyramid hamesha upright, biomass aquatic mein inverted — ye MCQ mein pakka aata hai
Immunity — Active (body banata hai, slow but long lasting) vs Passive (ready-made, fast but short) — har saal
Reading time mein Section C/D ke OR options dono padho — easier wala choose karo
Set number aur question number clearly likho

2 essay answers × 15 min. Detailed diagram + explanation.
